kitEvidence.formula:
Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to enemies hit. Refunds [60]% of this Ability's Cooldown.

Hold: Pantheon hurls his spear, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP] physical damage to the first enemy hit and [50]% less to further targets. 

This Ability is enhanced against enemies below [20]% Health to deal [(70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + 85 / 130 / 175 / 220 / 265) + (2.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage instead.

Mortal Will Bonus: Deals an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 240; raw flags preserved) + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
